annotations.title: Read the projection of an Italian comune with its uncertainty band

description: Reads the statistical projection of one Italian comune for the year after the latest ISTAT year: total, hotel and non-hotel nights and arrivals. Use it for what to expect next; do not use it for past figures (use leggi_serie_comune instead) or to compare comuni (use confronta_comuni instead). `cod_istat` (from cerca_comune) is the only input: it picks the comune, while the projected year cannot be chosen and is returned in `anno_orizzonte`. Figures are estimates, not official statistics; only the total has an uncertainty band. If projections are not public or nothing is stored, `linee` is an empty list and `nota` says why, not an error. An unknown code is an error saying what to pass. Public, no authentication; 30 requests per minute per client, shared across tools.

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of the comune, as a string with leading zeros kept ("058091" is Roma).

name: leggi_previsioni_comune

anno_orizzonte.description: The one year projected: the year after the latest year with ISTAT yearly figures. Null when no projection is stored for this comune or projections are not public (see `nota`).

cod_istat.description: 6-digit ISTAT code of the comune, as a string with leading zeros kept.

fonte.description: Source to cite with the figures: processed by DatiTuristici.it from institutional data (ISTAT).

linee.description: The four lines in the order totale, alberghieri, extra, arrivi; an empty list when no projection is stored for this comune or projections are not public (see `nota`).

affidabilita_pct.description: Reliability from 0 to 100: 100 minus the percent error the model made when it projected `anno_di_prova` from the earlier years only, floored at 0. Null when the line is not available, when too few earlier years allowed the test, or when the projection comes from the yearly job for comuni, which measures its accuracy by size class of comuni and not for each comune (see `nota`).

anno_di_prova.description: The year on which the reliability was measured; null when the line is not available or `affidabilita_pct` is null.

disponibile.description: True when this line has a projection; false when it was rejected (see `motivo`) and its numbers are null.

linea.description: What is projected: totale = nights spent in all establishments, alberghieri = nights in hotels, extra = nights in non-hotel establishments, arrivi = guest arrivals.

motivo.description: Why the line is not projected, null when it is: nessun_dato = no figure in the recent years the check looks at; serie_corta = a recent year is missing; zeri = a recent year is zero; salto = a jump between consecutive years too large to project from (the 2025 change of ISTAT scope is not counted as a jump); senza_totale = the line itself passes but `totale` does not, and every other line is anchored to it.

p10.description: Lower end of the uncertainty band: the 10th percentile of the model's forecast or, when `nota` says the total adds any months ISTAT has already published, those months (if any) plus the sum of the monthly 10th percentiles of the projected months, a wider band than a plain 10th percentile. Only the line totale has it; null for the others.

p90.description: Upper end of the uncertainty band: the 90th percentile of the model's forecast or, when `nota` says the total adds any months ISTAT has already published, those months (if any) plus the sum of the monthly 90th percentiles of the projected months, a wider band than a plain 90th percentile. Only the line totale has it; null for the others.

proiettato.description: The projected figure for `anno_orizzonte` (nights, or arrivals for the line arrivi). For totale it is the median of the model's forecast for the year or, when `nota` says the total adds any months ISTAT has already published, those months (if any) plus the projected remaining months. alberghieri, extra and arrivi may be derived from the total, as `nota` says. Null when the line is not available.

reale_anno_prima.description: The real figure of the year before `anno_orizzonte`, the latest year with ISTAT figures, to set beside `proiettato`; null when the line is not available.

metodo.description: Name of the statistical model that made the projections; null when none is stored or projections are not public.

nota.description: Notes in English on reading the projection: what it is, how the total and its band are built when the year adds any months ISTAT has already published, which lines are not projected and why, which may be derived from the total, where reliability is missing, and the change of ISTAT scope in 2025. When no projection is stored, or projections are not public, it says so.

scheda.description: Link to the comune's public page on datituristici.it, to cite.

soglia_affidabilita_bassa.description: Reliability percentage below which the site labels a projection as low; null when no projection is stored or projections are not public.

title: Read the projection of an Italian comune with its uncertainty band
